scene.description: A photorealistic portrait of a real man in a snow-covered forest near Winterfell; faint mist drifts among pine trunks.
scene.environment: Icy northern woods with frost-covered branches and scattered wolf tracks in the snow.
scene.mood: Disciplined, solemn, and quietly honorable — the silence of a Northern warrior who has seen too much.

aesthetic.style: Cinematic fantasy realism in the tone of Game of Thrones.
aesthetic.look: Cold bluish tone, strong northern contrast, faint fog diffusion, visible snow flurries; fine cinematic depth of field.

lighting.description: Overcast daylight filtered through mist; soft, cold ambient fill from snow; subtle rim light defining silhouette edges.

demographics.build: Athletic, lean, defined by a swordsman's discipline.

appearance.hair: Dark moss-green, slightly frosted at tips; windswept strands across forehead.
appearance.skin: Fair northern complexion with faint battle scars.
appearance.expression: Calm intensity, eyes half-closed as if listening to the wind.

pose.action: Sitting on a snow-dusted log; two swords planted blade-first into the ground before him; the third resting across his shoulder.
pose.framing: Medium shot, waist-up or slightly wider; centered with slight diagonal composition; mist and snow depth in background.

wardrobe.outerwear: Thick gray wolf-fur cloak with Stark insignia clasp at collar.
wardrobe.armor: Layered northern leather vest reinforced with steel plates.
wardrobe.accessories: Dark green headband tied at the back; belt carrying three scabbards with distinct hilts.

props_in_scene.background: Winter forest with pine trees fading into mist; faint ruins of a watchtower in distance.
props_in_scene.foreground: Snow-covered log and swords with snowflake sparkle detail.

camera_technical.requirements: Maintain realistic anatomy; visible breath vapor; accurate sword reflection behavior.
camera_technical.capture: Cinematic lens ~50mm equiv, shallow depth f/2.8, ISO ~200, shutter 1/250s, WB 6000K with blue tint. Shot on Canon EOS R5, natural color grading, realistic human skin pores, lens blur bokeh, subtle film grain texture, ultra-realistic human photography.
camera_technical.composition: Subject centered, slight left lean; depth layered with fog and snow particles; swords lead eye into frame.
camera_technical.retouching: Preserve natural textures of fur, metal, and snow; avoid digital smoothness.
camera_technical.avoid: Modern elements, bright fantasy armor, exaggerated anime features, or visible text/logos.
